description: Type a service token that would outlive the token creating it. Observed live 2026-11-18: authenticated with a service token that expires, `POST /v1/service_token` with `expires_in_seconds` past the caller's own expiry, or with `expires_in_seconds` omitted (a token that never expires), answers 403 text/plain `An expiring token cannot create a service token that outlives it. Set expires_in_seconds to at most 31047135. [...]`. The number is the seconds left on the calling token, so a caller can retry with it; `expires_in_seconds: 31000000` then answered 200. The spec declares only a status-wide 403. The class matches the message because a permission denial shares the status, and it declares 400 because the request, not the caller's access, is what to change.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The calling token expires, and the requested token would outlive it. The message ends with "Set expires_in_seconds to at most <seconds>.", the seconds left on the calling token.

message.includes: cannot create a service token that outlives it
